US President Donald Trump’s claim on Tuesday that Washington would catch up to China on rare earth supplies “within 10 months” is “unrealistic” and “diplomatic bluster”, given Beijing’s decades-long dominance in supply chains, experts say.
“The US will not catch up with China in rare earths production, processing or end-user rare earth-enabled product manufacturing in the next 10 months or the next 10 years,” said Jack Lifton, co-chairman of the Critical Minerals Institute, a global think...
